title: Polynomial-time construction of a prefixed output
statement: Let $p$ be a Boolean-valued function on bit strings and $f$ a bit-string-valued function. If the functions $x\mapsto[p(x)]$ and $f$ are polynomial-time computable, then the function $x\mapsto p(x)::f(x)$, which prefixes the output of $f$ with the bit $p(x)$, is polynomial-time computable.
